html: The same KEAP1-NRF2 core in two flow directions, to choose one for the new map. Both are laid out by a person's story: the main column from the NFE2L2 gene to NRF2's degradation, the ligase beside it with its three modifications beyond, the escape to the nucleus on the near side. Left to right is the top-to-bottom drawing turned. No overlaps, one crossing (the feedback from NRF2:MAFG to the KEAP1 gene).
